jobs.description:
Description:

**A Few Things About Us**

Welcome to Diverzify+! We are the largest and most respected commercial flooring installation service company in the industry, with 60+ locations across the U.S. and a team of nearly 2,300. Our innovative vision and partnerships with top companies set us apart. Working with us means joining a fun and hardworking team. We offer competitive pay and total rewards (Medical, Dental, Vision, Telemedical, Mental Health, Prescriptions, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D, and 401k Company Match). Come join us and be a part of something amazing!

**Job Summary**

At Diverzify+ and our Family of Brands, our Project Coordinators work closely with Project Managers to plan and execute flooring projects from start to finish. Responsibilities include creating action plans, scheduling resources, managing budgets and timelines, coordinating tasks, handling risk management, and maintaining project documentation. They ensure projects meet quality standards, stay on budget, and deliver customer satisfaction through effective communication and time management.

Requirements:

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage paperwork flow for Account Managers' or Executives' projects, verifying contracts, POs, and change orders for accuracy
* Build customer relations through timely document return and create routing sheets to track paperwork
* Communicate with suppliers about product availability and place/track material orders
* Make freight arrangements for cost-effective product shipments
* Perform timely follow-ups on shipments and track multiple deliveries
* Distribute bi-monthly Salesperson billing summary sheets for customer billing
* Maintain project documentation in job folders and the computer system
* Prepare monthly AIA-type billing and ensure job folders support payment verifications and final invoicing
* Review change orders, verify billing documents, and submit for client approval
* Complete accurate billing and follow up with clients for payment verification
* Prepare necessary project close-outs at project completion.

**Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in a Construction Administration role.
* Experience in project management, from conception to delivery.
* An ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules, and step-by-step action plans.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Microsoft Planner.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BSc in Business Administration or related field
* Experience as a Project Coordinator role or similar within the construction industry.
* Familiarity with risk management and quality assurance control
* Hands-on experience with project management tools
* PMP / PRINCE2 certification

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

ED ART STUDIO is a creative community dedicated to helping young adults of all abilities explore their talents through art and connect with society. We support our students in developing independent living skills, creativity, and social confidence, and we guide them toward their goals in higher education and careers.

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Community Clinic Association of Los Angeles County (CCALAC) is a non-profit membership organization that provides a wide variety of essential services to community health centers that serve the Los Angeles region. Founded in 1994, CCALAC’s mission is to “empower health centers to remain at the forefront of health care transformation. We forge partnerships, foster innovation, promote health equity, and advocate for the communities they serve.”

CCALAC represents 68 community health center organizations that provide comprehensive primary, dental and behavioral health services throughout Los Angeles County. Health centers in Los Angeles serve 2.18 million patients annually regardless of ability to pay. These organizations include private, non-profit, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), and community health centers.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Communications Manager, the Communications Coordinator is responsible for activities that support CCALAC’s communications strategy. This includes media relations, internal and external communications development, event promotion and digital media. The Communications Coordinator is responsible for developing and implementing media and social media strategies to advance the mission and vision of CCALAC members and further the advocacy and public relations goals of the organization.

**JOB DUTIES**

**COMMUNICATIONS**

* Support the Communications Manager with CCALAC’s communications strategy.
* Collaborate with the Communications Manager to develop materials for public relations (e.g., press releases, statements, op-ed articles, etc.).
* Develop and maintain media lists.
* Contribute ideas to, draft copy for, and design member newsletter.
* Coordinate networking and best practice sharing among member communications and marketing leads in collaboration with Communications Manager.

**BRANDING AND DESIGN**

* Support the organization’s external image and branding by ensuring adherence of all CCALAC communication materials to the organization’s style guide. This includes maintaining the style guide, and supporting CCALAC divisions and individuals with development and edits of internal and external communication materials.
* Create graphics, flyers, PowerPoints and branded items using tools like Canva or Google Slides.

**DIGITAL MEDIA**

* Create original social media content (photos, graphics and video) to highlight CCALAC and member achievements, events and critical issues impacting health centers and their patients.
* Monitor social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and respond to comments and inquiries.
* Collaborate with Communications Manager to engage key audiences and partners and to foster relationships online.
* Organize digital media library and develop a catalogue system for content.
* Periodically visit member clinics and attend member events across Los Angeles to take photos and videos.
* Create analytics reports.
* Identify emerging social media trends and make recommendations on if/how CCALAC should incorporate them into the organization’s strategy.
* Assist with writing and updating website content.

**EVENTS**

* Design, create and edit invitations, flyers, posters and other print and electronic materials.
* Promote events via marketing emails, social media, targeted outreach and other methods.
* Photograph and record events as needed.
* Assist in the promotion and coordination of activities for the annual National Health Center Week.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Assist the Senior Director of Government and External Affairs and CCALAC leadership with other duties as assigned to advance the organization’s mission and vision.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

1. Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communication, or digital media related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

2. A minimum of three years of related communications experience.

3. Ability to maintain confidential information.

4. Knowledge of or familiarity with health care, health policy issues, and/or Los Angeles County health care system preferred.

5. Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently with minimal supervision.

6. Strong reading comprehension, oral, and written skills required.

7. Strong skills with Excel & MS Office Suite required.

8. Ability to draft content that is succinct, grammatically correct and error free.

9. Experience presenting information in written, graphic, and verbal formats.

10. Experience with social media, branding, marketing, and communications strategy.

11. Experience creating materials including simple promotional flyers, infographics, digital graphics, presentations, memos, issue briefs, and reports.

12. Familiarity with software for document and materials creation (e.g., PowerPoint, Adobe CC, Canva, Google Slides, etc.), and making simple photo edits (e.g., cropping, brightening).

13. Experience/familiarity with email marketing platforms.

14. Follow directions and respond positively to constructive feedback.

15. Manage time effectively and pay excellent attention to detail.

16. Comfortable advocating for or against policies that affect community health centers.

17. Flexibility to adapt as priorities shift/change.

18. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, organization leadership and external partners.

19. Strong sense of accountability to community.

**LOCATION:** Candidates must reside in one of the following Southern California counties: Los Angeles, Ventura, Santa Barbara, Kern, San Luis Obispo, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego and Imperial.

**About GFFG:**

GFFG is a Seoul-based hospitality group behind some of Korea’s most beloved food and beverage brands, including Cafe Knotted and Hojokban. GFFG America Inc. brings these concepts to the U.S. Cafe Knotted, a dessert cafe and bakery from Seoul, is open in Los Angeles at Westfield Century City and in the Arts District. Hojokban, the Korean restaurant founded in Seoul’s Cheongdam neighborhood, opened in New York City in 2023 and in Los Angeles’ Arts District in November 2025. Learn more at www.gffg.co.kr.

**Position Overview:**

GFFG America is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator to shape the visual identity and online presence of our brands in the U.S. This role sits within our Brand Strategy team and works across Cafe Knotted and Hojokban, producing design assets, creating and publishing social content, managing our online reputation, and building relationships with creators and media.

This is an on-site position based in Los Angeles, typically working out of our Arts District locations with regular visits to Cafe Knotted Westfield Century City. The ideal candidate is a strong designer who is equally comfortable behind a camera, inside a content calendar, and in a guest review inbox.

**Schedule:**

The typical schedule is Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm. Hours are flexible and will shift as needed to capture content and support events, including some evenings and weekends.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

*Graphic Design & Print Production:*

* Produce polished, on-brand design assets using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) across social media, web, advertising, menus, signage, and packaging

* Maintain and enforce brand guidelines for each brand, ensuring visual consistency across every touchpoint
* Manage updates to menus, promotional materials, website visuals, and in-store displays so guest-facing information is always accurate
* Adapt designs across digital, print, packaging, multimedia, and experiential formats
* Organize and maintain a structured digital asset library
* Coordinate with external vendors and printers on menu printing, signage, and collateral to ensure production quality and on-time delivery

*Social Media & Content Creation:*

* Plan, create, schedule, and publish 2–3 posts and Reels per week per brand, maintaining a content calendar at least one week ahead

* Monitor DMs, comments, and tagged content daily; engage with the community and repost guest content
* Analyze social performance and engagement data to inform content strategy and improve reach
* Stay current with design trends, platform changes, and hospitality marketing best practices

*Reputation Management:*

* Monitor and respond to guest reviews on Google, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash promptly and professionally, in a voice consistent with each brand and our hospitality standards
* Maintain and optimize business listings (Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, DoorDash) for accuracy, imagery, and completeness
* Track review trends and surface recurring guest feedback to on-site leadership

*Website, SEO / GEO & Digital Marketing:*

* Maintain website content and visuals for both brands
* Support search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) efforts so our brands are discoverable on Google, Maps, and AI-driven search
* Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns, monitoring performance and adjusting as needed

*Creator & Media Outreach:*

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to local creators, influencers, and media who fit each brand

* Assist in organizing and executing special marketing events, campaigns, and collaborations

* 2+ years of graphic design experience (hospitality, food & beverage, or lifestyle brands preferred)

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); experience with Figma, Canva, CapCut, or Premiere a plus
* Hands-on experience managing brand social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok) including content creation, scheduling, and analytics
* Photography and short-form video skills, including RAW photo editing; comfortable shooting on-site with a phone and/or camera
* Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash merchant tools, Google Ads, and basic SEO principles
* Strong written communication skills; able to write in multiple brand voices
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Korean language proficiency strongly preferred but not required; familiarity with Korean food culture a plus
* Must have reliable transportation for travel between Los Angeles locations

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* $55,000–$70,000 annual salary, based on experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.title: Plant Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:

Discover a workplace where you're truly valued — and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, development and success.

* Excellent benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, flexible spending accounts, and a Safe Harbor 401(k) plan with guaranteed company match!
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), Flex Holidays, and 6 Paid holidays per year for full-time staff.
* $2,000 a year in Tuition Assistance for full-time employees and robust Talent Development Program – we help you accelerate your career!
* Wellness program with the opportunity to earn a 30% discount on your benefit premiums!
* Employee Meal Program coming! We will prepare delicious meals for you daily!

The Plant Operations Coordinator supports the Plant Operations department, and is responsible for invoices, inventory, ordering supplies, and reporting. They also receive calls from residents and employees requesting maintenance work to be done in the community.

This is a full time, onsite, position located in Woodland Hills, California.

**Compensation: $24.80 per hour.**

PRINCIPLE DUTIES:

* Receives and codes plant operations invoices via the Accounts Payable system.

* Invoices residents and other departments for work orders.

* Keeps an accurate inventory of plant operation’s supplies and equipment, tracks use of and orders supplies as needed. Ensure an adequate supply of all maintenance supplies is stocked and available when needed.

* Clearly labels and stores all supplies so that maintenance personnel can easily obtain them in a timely manner.

* Maintains a positive rapport with vendors and ensures that pricing for supplies and equipment is the best that can be obtained, to maintain budgetary requirements. Research pricing for supplies and equipment and secures the best prices on an ongoing basis. Keeps the Plant Operations Director informed of price increases and changes in product lines.

* Completes monthly and quarterly plant operations reports as needed including but not limited to QI/QA, comment cards, utility usage etc.

* Active participant in the Safety Program and supports Director with tracking of required safety trainings/compliance.

* Accepting calls and emails from residents and employees for work orders & other assistance, displaying good judgment and excellent telephone etiquette.

* Returning calls and emails within one business day; timeline is provided as to when work will be completed.

* Entering work orders into the system accurately and completed by the end of the business day.

* Support Director in managing/assigning work orders to technicians.

* Maintains pertinent records, reports, and studies. Also, maintains and tracks inventory.

* Maintains a high level of customer service for residents, guests, and other departments.

* Ensure that community is in State and Federal compliance and track various renewal dates.

* Performs other duties as assigned by the director.

QUALIFICATIONS:

* At least three-year experience as a Coordinator, preferably in the plant operations department in a retirement and/or healthcare setting

* Strong phone skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Excellent customer service skills

* Excellent organizational skills

* Works cooperatively with peers and is a team player.

* Strong computer knowledge, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Knowledge of Access a plus.

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. It also provides support to our national marketing team.

* Keep internal documents updated, including contact lists, organizational charts and calendars
Assists with special projects, as needed

Oversees referral program, including tracking and processing team member referral fees and obtaining all necessary approvals  

**Market & Business Development Support**

Project coordination for sales & marketing programs

* Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

* Interest in sales, hospitality, live events, or venue operations.

jobs.title: Marketing and Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About Cinelease**

Since 1977, Cinelease has supported the film and television industry with lighting and grip equipment, production services, and studio facilities. Our reputation is built on exceptional service, industry expertise, and a commitment to helping productions succeed.

We are looking for a creative, organized Marketing & Social Media Manager to bring the Cinelease story to life through compelling content, thoughtful design, and engaging digital campaigns.

**About the Role**

The Marketing & Social Media Manager will manage Cinelease’s social media presence, develop campaign concepts, and create marketing assets that strengthen

brand awareness and customer engagement across our divisions. Working closely with marketing leadership, project directors, and internal teams, you will

translate business priorities into clear messaging and effective creative work. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys both developing ideas and bringing them to life.

An initial priority will be evaluating Cinelease’s social media channels and implementing a coordinated plan to improve content quality, brand consistency, and audience engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Management**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing, aligning content with company initiatives, services, events, and relevant industry conversations.
* Write and publish content tailored to each platform, manage community engagement, and connect customer inquiries with the appropriate teams.
* Monitor channel performance, audience insights, and emerging trends to recommend improvements and report on reach, engagement, website traffic, and

relevant inquiries.

**Creative Content & Campaign Management**

* Develop campaign concepts and stories that showcase Cinelease’s people, equipment, facilities, and services while supporting the broader brand strategy.
* Capture and edit photography and video, and create graphics for digital campaigns, sales materials, merchandise, and internal communications.
* Manage assigned creative projects from concept through publication, collaborating with internal teams and outside partners to coordinate priorities,

timelines, feedback, and approvals.

* Maintain consistent messaging and design across divisions and channels, including creative support for website updates and customer-facing digital

initiatives.

* Organize creative assets and ensure published content is accurate, approved, and respectful of usage permissions and production confidentiality.

* At least three years of relevant experience in marketing, social media management, creative content production, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating graphic design, photography, video editing, and social media content, with a clear explanation of your contribution.
* Experience managing business social media accounts and using publishing and analytics tools to guide improvements.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable design, photo editing, and video production tools.
* Practical knowledge of camera operation, lighting, audio capture, composition, and editing.
* Strong writing, proofreading, organization, and project management skills.
* Sound creative judgment and the ability to manage overlapping deadlines, incorporate feedback, and collaborate across teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with film and television production, equipment rental, studio operations, or related business-to-business services.
* Experience supporting multiple locations, divisions, or brands.
* Motion graphics, basic animation, paid social campaign support, or website content management experience.
* A degree in marketing, communications, graphic design, film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means a consistent, engaging social media presence; creative work that clearly communicates Cinelease’s capabilities; reliable campaign delivery; and measurable improvements in audience engagement and relevant customer interest. You will help establish an efficient creative workflow that supports planned campaigns and timely opportunities.

**Why Cinelease**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how Cinelease’s people, expertise, and services are represented across its marketing channels. You will collaborate with teams supporting film and television production and see your ideas become content used throughout the business.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Introduction:

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview:

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Marketing Operations Specialist who enjoys turning strategy into efficient, scalable execution. You'll combine marketing technology, process management, data, and cross-functional coordination to help campaigns move smoothly from intake through launch and reporting. Curious and solutions-oriented, you can juggle multiple priorities, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and support teams in using marketing tools effectively and consistently.

The versatile Marketing Operations Specialist will support the day-to-day operation of the bank's marketing technology, campaign workflows, lead management, reporting, and governance processes. A key priority will be building scalable, behavior-triggered automation that delivers timely, relevant communications based on customer and prospect engagement, such as a follow-up email after an eligible visitor views a product page. You'll partner with Marketing teams, IT, Compliance, business units, and external vendors to coordinate campaigns, maintain data quality, document processes, troubleshoot issues, and help deliver timely, compliant, and measurable marketing programs.

Responsibilities:

* Support the planning, setup, testing, launch, and monitoring of marketing campaigns across email, events, web forms, and other digital channels
* Manage campaign intake, timelines, approvals, audience lists, quality assurance, and deployment checklists to help ensure accurate and on-time execution
* Build, maintain, and optimize automated customer journeys and behavior-triggered campaigns, including timely follow-up communications based on eligible website activity, product-page engagement, form submissions, and other defined signals
* Coordinate lead capture, routing, tracking, and handoff processes in partnership with Marketing and business teams
* Monitor data quality, consent, preferences, and audience segmentation practices in accordance with privacy, compliance, and governance requirements
* Build and maintain campaign reports, dashboards, and recurring performance updates; identify trends and opportunities for improvement
* Document workflows, standard operating procedures, platform configurations, and training materials
* Troubleshoot platform and campaign issues, coordinate resolution with internal partners and vendors, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders
* Support testing, implementation, and adoption of new marketing technology, integrations, and process improvements
* Stay current on marketing operations, automation, analytics, data privacy, and platform best practices

Qualifications:

* 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, campaign operations, CRM, digital marketing, or a related field
* Hands-on experience with marketing automation or customer engagement platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights -Journeys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar tools
* Experience building and supporting automated customer journeys, behavior-triggered email campaigns, audience segmentation, lead management, testing, and performance reporting
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholders
* Working knowledge of CRM data, data hygiene, consent management, and digital marketing compliance practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommended actions
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools such as Excel, SharePoint, and Copilot
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively across technical and nontechnical teams
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while balancing operational accuracy with continuous improvement

A plus if you have:

* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Power Bl, Power Automate, or related marketing technology
* Experience with system integrations, user acceptance testing, or platform implementations
* Banking, financial services, or another regulated industry experience
* Familiarity with event marketing, webinar platforms, web analytics, or digital asset management
* Relevant platform certifications

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $73,000.00/Yr. - USD $85,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
### **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative (1099 + Monthly Stipend)** **Job Summary**

We are looking for an enterprising, self-starting individual to join our team as a **B2B-SMB Outside Sales Representative**. As part of our field sales development team, you will recognize, prospect, and cultivate potential SMB (small and medium-sized business) sales leads, travel to meet directly with business owners and executive decision-makers face-to-face, and endeavor to transform initial sales conversations into lasting, high-value client relationships. Operating within your assigned local territory, you will promote WeLink's next-generation wireless fiber-like internet solutions as a superior, cost-effective alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. You will leverage your expertise in direct sales, door-to-door prospecting, territory management, and consultative selling to demonstrate how WeLink's telecom technology optimizes business connectivity and improves their bottom line.

### **Outside Sales Representative Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Territory & Field Prospecting:** Travel daily within your designated sales territory to initiate cold visits, build boots-on-the-ground lead pipelines, and meet face-to-face with SMB decision-makers.
* **Consultative Product Presentation:** Maintain comprehensive, expert-level knowledge of WeLink's high-speed internet products, telecom infrastructure, and cloud connectivity services to effectively differentiate our solutions from incumbent providers.
* **Pipeline & CRM Management:** Rigorously manage, track, and update all sales leads, account activities, funnel stages, and closed deals within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.
* **Consultative Deal Closing:** Conduct professional needs assessments, overcome client objections, present tailored business proposals, and utilize proven closing strategies to meet or exceed monthly revenue targets.
* **Relationship Building & Post-Sale Support:** Coordinate with sales leadership and operational installation teams to ensure seamless onboarding, maintaining ongoing client touchpoints to realize cross-selling and referral opportunities.

### **Outside Sales Representative Requirements and Qualifications**

* **Sales & Industry Experience:** Proven track record in B2B sales, field sales, outside sales, business development, telecommunications, account management, or technology sales (prior experience selling SMB or MDU telecom solutions is a major plus).
* **Self-Motivated & Entrepreneurial:** A strong self-starting personality with an entrepreneurial spirit, high competitiveness, and the discipline to manage your own territory and schedule without constant supervision.
* **Communication & Negotiation:** Articulate, polished, and persuasive communication skills with a proven ability to establish instant credibility with executives and business owners.
* **Sales Methodology & Tools:** Deep understanding of full-cycle sales techniques, lead generation, sales funnel management, and proficiency with standard CRM software.
* **Mobility Requirements:** Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and reliable personal transportation to navigate your daily field territory. High school diploma or equivalent required.

### **What We Offer**

* **Uncapped 1099 Commission:** Six-figure earning potential directly tied to your performance with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure.
* **90-Day Ramp-Up Support:** A guaranteed **$2,000/month stipend** for your first 90 days of employment to support you as you establish your pipeline and launch your territory.

jobs.description:
**About Mehraban**

Mehraban is a third-generation Los Angeles rug company specializing in luxury handmade rugs for leading interior designers, architects, hospitality projects, and private residences.

Since 1945, we have combined generations of rug knowledge and craftsmanship with a contemporary approach to design. Our collections include one-of-a-kind, contemporary, antique, and fully custom rugs produced by skilled weaving partners around the world.

We are looking for a talented, highly organized **Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator** to join our Los Angeles team.

**The Role**

This is a hybrid **creative, technical, and production-focused position**.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, color, pattern, fashion, and interiors, while also being extremely detail-oriented and comfortable managing the technical and organizational side of custom rug production.

You will work closely with our sales and design teams, clients, interior designers, and international weaving mills to develop custom rugs from initial concept through production.

You will also contribute to Mehraban's creative development by researching emerging trends, colors, materials, fashion, art, and interiors and helping develop new rug concepts and collections.

**Custom Rug Design & Artwork**

* Create professional tear sheets and presentations for custom rug projects.
* Resize, rescale, repeat, crop, and adapt existing artwork to different rug dimensions and shapes.
* Engineer pattern repeats while maintaining the integrity and proportion of the original design.
* Develop custom colorways and recolor existing designs.
* Create rug renderings using Galaincha or similar textile/rug visualization software.
* Prepare Illustrator templates showing artwork, dimensions, colors, materials, and client/project information.
* Occasionally develop original rug designs and concepts for custom projects and Mehraban collections.

We know that our teams are the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.

We offer:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Onboarding
jobs.description:
#### **The Company**

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.

Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we have a team distributed across the NAM and EMEA regions.

We’re a bootstrapped and profitable company (over $29M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word-of-mouth excitement. We’re the go-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,100+ customers including top brands, agencies and networks*.*

Our Customer Success Manager, OM will possess the ability to meet or exceed all launch KPI’s; including but not limited to continuously minimizing time to first value, prescriptive guidance on the Everflow tools that support and grow our users’ businesses, and guide a smooth technical launch in collaboration with our Technical Solutions team.

* Lead the onboarding process for new customers, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to realized value in the shortest amount of time possible. Assist clients in the initial setup and configuration of the software, tailoring the implementation to meet their specific business needs.
* Ability to be a front-line Customer Success Manager from a relationship perspective. Build and maintain strong, multi threaded and long-lasting client relationships.
* Identify growth opportunities with customers, and develop and implement solutions to achieve revenue expansion goals.
* Develop expertise with new products and features and be able to evangelize them with clients.
* Understand the customer’s business goals and challenges in order to advocate for customer needs and to share feedback within the company to influence product development and service improvements.
* Monitor customer usage data and health metrics - Proactively identify any potential issues before they become problems and address accordingly.

#### **Qualifications**

* Ability to understand and explain technical concepts, as well as troubleshoot basic technical issues
* Ability to build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with clients, understanding their business goals, and acting as their trusted advisor
* Experience in sales or a strong understanding of sales principles, including the ability to negotiate contracts and upsell products or services
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering exceptional service and exceeding client expectations
* Strong problem-solving skills to address client issues, resolve conflicts, and find creative solutions to meet client needs - Consultative in approach

#### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 2-4 years experience in a similar role
* CRM tools like Hubspot/Jira (Basic)
* Experience using either Everflow or competitor tracking platforms (preferred but not required)
* Third Party analytics solutions - Google Analytics, Social/MediaBuying or MMPs (preferred but not required)

#### **Compensation Package:**

**Base Salary: $60,000 - $70,000**  
**Bonus Potential**

##### **Perks include:**

* Employer Covered Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
* 401(k) (No matching at this time)
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

#### **Join Our Exceptional Team**

Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.

##### **Balance, Growth, and Connection**

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.

**Continuous Growth:** Regular feedback and discussions about your career path keep you moving forward.

**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun.

**We offer a dynamic environment where excellence is rewarded, your well-being is a priority, and every day brings a chance to make meaningful connections. Ready for a truly rewarding challenge? We're excited to meet you.**

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Assistant Community (Property) Manager assists the Community Manager in the successful site management of the apartment community providing the necessary leadership, guidance and motivation to ensure a positive working environment and quality community living. The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for administering the day-to-day leasing office operations and is responsible for overseeing all computer input of the apartment community. The Assistant Community Manager directs the leasing staff, and works with the Community Manager to recommend marketing and leasing strategies designed to meet the goals of Shea Properties. The pay range for this position is $27.00 - $29.00/hour and the Assistant Community Manager is also eligible to participate in the office Sales Bonus, Club Shea Program and the discretionary annual bonus plan. JF Shea offers a competitive benefits package including PTO, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, 401K, disability, life insurance, 35% discounted apartment (based on availability), and cell phone allowance.

**Job Duties**

* Leads and participates in lineup each morning.
* Ensures craigslist ads are posted daily.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, supervises the input of all data into designated property management software and processing of related reports.
* Reviews and approves move out statements (SODA), ensuring all statements are completed timely in accordance with state law and that all charges are necessary and accurate as outlined in Shea Properties policies.
* Reviews and approves resident rental applications for move-ins in a fair and consistent manner in accordance with Fair Housing requirements and Shea Business Properties' policies and procedures.
* Assists in negotiation of rent increases and lease renewals with residents and supports the Community Manager in the execution of all necessary documents to implement all approved rental increases.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, coordinates with Leasing and Maintenance staff a calendar of scheduled move-ins, ensuring all move-in appointments are completed and all apartments are inspected prior to move-in.
* In conjunction with Community Manager reviews Yieldstar each morning and submits pricing recommendations.
* Maintains all residents and vendor files, ensuring completeness and accuracy of all paperwork and documentation.
* Under the direction of the Community Manager, ensures the preparation and delivery of all legal and formal notices, including Three Day or 30 Covenant to Quit, Rent Increase Notices, Late Charge Notices, and Notices of Violation of Community Rules and Regulations, in accordance to California Civil Code and Shea Properties policy and procedure.
* Ensures the maintenance of all account records and transactions including NSF's, Rent Allowances, Concessions, Rent Increases, Utility Billing Collection, and other management approved debits/credits.
* Prepares beginning of the week (Monday Morning) reports in an accurate and timely manner.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, directs the functions of the leasing office, supervise the leasing staff’s daily activities and the preparation of all leasing paperwork and documents related to residency. Ensures schedule of leasing staff to ensure proper staff levels in anticipation of traffic demands and workload.
* Acts as gate keeper for Avid Exchange
* Prepares work orders and submits for approval in Go Cart.
* Assists in the development, preparation and administration of the capital and operating budgets for the property.
* Participates in staff selection process. Recruits, hires, and trains all leasing staff under the approval and direction of the Community Manager.
* Prepares annual reviews for all direct reports, sets Incentive-Based Compensation Bonus Plan (IBC) goals and objectives and implements Professional Development Plans (PDP) for all associates.
* Supports and motivates staff to participate in company sponsored classes and provided training, with the objective of completing PDP and individual goals. Ensures compliance with all mandatory training.
* Oversee and/or conduct weekly sales “leasing fundamentals” meetings, sign and submit fundamentals to Regional Manager for review.
* Supports industry networking and encourages direct reports to participate in industry association functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Actual job duties and responsibilities may vary depending on the size of the community.
* Handle on-call duties, as directed by supervisor.

**Technical/Professional Knowledge (*****Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience*****)**

* Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to give clear direction and respond to inquiries.Must be able to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.
* Understanding of accounting principles and budget process. Ability to read and interpret numerical information. Basic understanding of the budgeting process.
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts; analyzing data; and report writing.
* Customer service experience required in at least one of the following industries: property management, hospitality, retail, and real estate.
* Negotiate and resolve conflicts.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (Word/Excel/Outlook) and Yardi & Yieldstar preferred.
* Prior experience in managing a staff (supervise, train, coach, develop, motivate, interview, hire, terminate) and lead by example.
* High School Diploma or equivalent. Some college level courses preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years property management experience with at least 1 year at the management level.

The Assistant Community Manager works on-site at an apartment community and interfaces with external/internal customers, residents, and vendors on a regular basis. The position work schedule varies depending on the property. Hours are usually scheduled from 9 a.m. – 6 p.m. However, office sta

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Program Coordinator

**Department Name:** GGU Worldwide

**Position Reports To:** Associate Director of Administration and Partner Support, GGU WW

**FLSA STATUS**: Salaried

**Salary Range:** $70,304.00

**Benefits:** The University's comprehensive benefits program

**Days & Hours:** Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week. The standard work schedule is 9:00 am to 5:30 pm, maybe adjusted. A flexible schedule may require evening and weekend hours.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE:**

The Program Coordinator provides timely, high-level administrative and academic support to GGU Worldwide’s Deans and Faculty Directors. This position is responsible for supporting the day-to-day administrative and coordinative operations of various international partner programs, requiring strong attention to detail, excellent interpersonal skills, cross-cultural communication, technical and AI skills, a commitment to student-centered service, academic quality assurance, and accreditor compliance. The role demands the ability to multi-task and adapt to varied responsibilities and time zones across GGU Worldwide programs, stakeholders, platforms, and geographies. The Program Coordinator provides dedicated administrative and logistical support to GGU Worldwide’s partnerships.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Work collaboratively as part of the GGU Worldwide administrative team to deliver timely, quality, and focused care and support to students, faculty, staff, and partners.
* Assist Faculty Directors with course scheduling, syllabi management, instructor selection, student evaluations, timesheet tracking, record keeping, and other academic operations.
* Support Faculty Directors with pre-admission, enrollment, verification, course enrollment, attendance monitoring, student standards status, WASC reports, translation/interpretation, and academic quality initiatives and etc.
* Use platforms such as Curriculog to support curriculum changes and Smartsheet to manage course schedules.
* Serve as the point of contact for partner adjunct faculty onboarding, support, and coordination.
* Assist Dean and Associate Dean with special projects and doctoral programs.
* Assure GGU Worldwide courses and programs in the GGU Catalog, all websites, and social media pages, and marketing materials are up to date.
* Course schedule planning, coordination, confirmation, and oversight.
* Help Faculty Director and Deans monitor faculty-student course engagement.
* Coordinate with other university departments, including Student accounts, Division of Student Success, facilities, schools, among others.
* Assist deans, faculty directors and faculty on outreach, partner relations, and students’ associations.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments and meetings; utilize strong judgment in managing priorities of requests and escalating as necessary for resolution and/or prioritization.
* Prepare documents, reports, agendas, presentations, and related materials.
* Assist with on campus and off campus events, orientations, immersions, commencement, and other activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Education requirement:
  + Bachelor's degree; Master’s degree a plus
* Years of experience:
  + Two to five years’ experience in academic program support role or similar is preferred.
* Knowledge of:
  + English and other languages is preferred but not required.
  + Curriculog, Salesforce, Colleague, and Smartsheet are preferred but not required.
  + AI tools, LinkedIn, and short messaging apps including WhatsApp, WeChat, Viber.
* Direct job-related requirements:
  + Familiarity with CRM and learning management systems
  + High level of proficiency with modern office practices, procedures, equipment, and software, including Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, MS Teams and other office technology.
* Skills and abilities:
  + Ability to work on-site at the San Francisco, California campus.
  + Ability to work off-site activities including but not limited to immersions, study tours, community events.
  + Strong interpersonal and bilingual skills with the ability to maintain positive and professional relationships with students, faculty, staff, and partners.
  + Ability to work in a multicultural, diverse, and inclusive environment.
  + Excellent interpersonal, administrative, communication, and organizational skills.
  + Outstanding command of the English language in written and verbal forms.
  + Ability to effectively interpret, organize, and present information and ideas in writing.
  + Excellent project management skills, including ability to simultaneously manage several projects and activities, as well as use AI tools.
  + Work effectively both as a leader and as a team member to support departmental goals, providing assistance across programs while consistently prioritizing the best interests of students and graduates.

jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.
* Others duties as assigned.

High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

jobs.description:
**THE ROLE**  
StreamU is hiring a Host / Production Coordinator to be both an on-camera presence and the connective tissue between StreamU and the people we work with. This is a hybrid role: part host, part social & marketing lead, and part day-to-day communication hub for our university and athlete clients.  
  
You’ll set the tone on air, keep our social and marketing engine running, and make sure universities  
and athletes always know what’s next — while relaying their needs back to the production team  
internally. If you’re organized, comfortable on camera, and a natural communicator, this role sits  
right at the center of everything StreamU does.  
  
Graduating students, young professionals, and candidates with strong relevant experience are all  
encouraged to apply.  
  
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Host & On-Camera Presence: Host streams and segments, set the energy, and represent the StreamU brand to every viewer — keeping content authentic, on-brand, and professional.
* Social & Marketing: Plan, create, and publish content across platforms to grow our audience, promote streams and  
  activations, and keep StreamU’s voice consistent everywhere it shows up.
* Client Communication — University & Athlete: Serve as the friendly day-to-day point of contact for university and athlete clients. Handle onboarding, scheduling, and check-ins, and make sure every client feels informed and supported.
* Internal & Production Coordination: Keep the production team aligned — relay client needs internally, coordinate stream  
  schedules and talking points, and help the run of show come together across athletes and university partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**  
*On-camera comfort*. A natural, engaging presence and the ability to carry a stream, set the tone, and keep it professional.  
Social & marketing savvy. A feel for content, platforms, and brand voice — and the discipline to publish consistently and on-brand.  
*Strong communication & organization.* You’re responsive, dependable, and comfortable being the point of contact who keeps clients and teammates in the loop.  
*Client-first instincts.* You make universities and athletes feel supported, and you can translate their needs into clear direction for the internal team.  
*Streaming culture fluency.* Familiarity with the Twitch, Kick, and X (Twitter) ecosystems is a strong plus.  
*The right stage in your career.* A young professional, a graduating student, or someone with great relevant experience is all welcome.  
  
**Where This Role Sits**  
You’ll work across these lanes every week:  
Host — on-camera & brand  
Social & Marketing — content & growth  
University Clients — comms & onboarding  
Athlete Clients — comms & scheduling  
Internal Comms — relay & align  
Production — run of show  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - GI Division
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will join the GI Division and responsibilities will include coordination of clinical research studies related liver disease and liver transplantation. The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies. The CRC will work on the DeLIVER Care, provides HCV screening and low-threshold standard of care HCV treatment on at various locations in San Francisco on a mobile van.

CRC’s duties may include, management and coordinating the tasks of multiple clinical research studies, act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist PI supervisor with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will also be responsible for performing fingersticks for rapid HCV antibody testing and/or HCV RNA, venipuncture for HCV RNA confirmatory testing and other labs, driving the van, and completing research activities such as consenting participants, extracting information from medical records, completing case report forms, data collection, and data entry. The CRC is required to be experienced in research with “hard-to-reach” and vulnerable populations, knowledge of resources for HCV and HIV prevention and education, drug abuse prevention and treatment, and street and community-based outreach methods. Phlebotomy certification is preferred, but not required. Having experience performing phlebotomy with people experiencing homelessness and people who inject drugs is preferable.

  

Required Qualifications:

* California Driver's License
* High Schol Diplima; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines

Preferred Qualifications:

* BA or BS in physical or biological sciences and one year of clinical research experience
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:

  + Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
  + Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
  + The Protection of Human Research Subjects
  + CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
  + Effective Cash Handling Procedures
  + Environmental Health and Safety Training
  + Fire Safety Training
  + Experience working with programs serving people experiencing homelessness and/or substance dependence

License/Certifications:

* California Driver's License

  + Does the job demonstrably require driving as a core function? Yes
  + Can the essential tasks of the role be performed adequately without driving? No- the CRC will be responsible for driving the van to and from outreach shifts and vehicle maintenance services
  + If driving is required, would using alternative transportation (like public transit, carpooling) significantly impact the employee's ability to perform job duties in terms of time and cost to the employer? Yes
  + If required to drive, will use of a university vehicle be required? Yes
  + Will use of a personal vehicle be required? No
  + Will the position be required to drive frequently (more than 10 hours month)? Yes
  + Will position be required to drive outside of city or county limits? Yes
  + Will position need to register with the California Pull Program? Yes

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Sobhani Research Group (PI: Nasim Sobhani) is dedicated to improving the care of pregnant individual and their infants. The bulk of our studies are focused on diabetes in pregnancy and how to optimize the care of pregnant people living with diabetes. Our studies examine how to improve perinatal outcomes for pregnant individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes; leverage advanced diabetes technology in the pregnant population; diagnose and manage gestational diabetes; and better support the emotional and behavioral needs of pregnant individuals with diabetes.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.

Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports, including ensuring complete and accurate data capture; attend regular meetings with the PI and/or other members of the study team; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; support the development and submission of publications, presentations, reports, and other study-related documents; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will assist the Sobhani Research Group with multiple projects. The CRC will design and develop RedCap databases, enroll patients in research studies and complete chart reviews, data collection and data for later data analysis. The CRC will also perform and/or coordinate biospecimen collection with study participants, coordinate with research team staff, perform initial sample processing and stabilization, and ensure transfer of the specimens to partnering research labs as needed. The CRC will work on IRB/CHR applications and submit protocols, regulatory documents, modifications and updates to the CHR for various ongoing studies. The CRC will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and collaborators across departments within UCSF as well as non-UCSF campuses. This includes outreach and communication with referring healthcare providers and patient support organizations.

A successful candidate will have a desire to work directly with patients; be passionate about supporting research studies that aim to improve our understanding of pregnancy complications; be dedicated to optimizing the care of individuals with medically complex pregnancies; be committed to the development of evidence-based practices. They will be an independent problem-solver with excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. They will have a high level of professionalism, an exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously. This is a great opportunity for an individual who is interested in academic research, medicine, health care, or public health. A two-year commitment is preferred.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the new Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $150 million. The Department has 134 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 22 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff.

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

jobs.title: Network Development Coordinator
jobs.description:

At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose-built tools, and a team-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.

Altais includes a network of physician-led organizations across California, including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.

The Network Development Coordinator supports the Network Development Manager in executing initiatives related to provider recruitment, onboarding, and engagement across Altais’s Networks of Care (including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Care Network, and Family Care Specialist IPA).

This role is responsible for coordinating outreach efforts, supporting onboarding processes, maintaining provider data, and assisting with relationship management activities to ensure a smooth and efficient experience for prospective and newly contracted providers. The Coordinator plays a key role in operational execution, process support, and cross-functional coordination.

**This position is a hybrid opportunity in the region you're assigned to.**

**Candidates considered for this role must live in California with preference to those in Northern California.**

**You will focus on:**

**Provider Recruitment Support:**

Assist in identifying prospective physicians and providers by conducting research, maintaining lead lists, and supporting outreach efforts. Coordinate initial communications and schedule meetings for the Network Development Manager.

**Provider Onboarding Coordination:**

Support the onboarding process for new providers by coordinating documentation, tracking onboarding steps, and partnering with internal teams (e.g., credentialing, contracting) to ensure timely completion of requirements.

**Provider Engagement Support:**

Assist in maintaining relationships with prospective and newly onboarded providers by coordinating follow-ups, responding to basic inquiries, and escalating issues to the Network Development Manager as needed.

**Presentation & Event Coordination:**

Support preparation of presentation materials, proposals, and outreach content. Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, and presentations (in-person and virtual), including scheduling, materials, and follow-up communication.

**Market & Data Support:**

Conduct basic market research and maintain tracking tools related to provider outreach, recruitment pipelines, and network development activities. Compile data and assist in reporting for leadership review.

**Service & Program Knowledge:**

Maintain working knowledge of organizational services and provider offerings to support accurate communication and coordination efforts.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

Partner with internal teams (marketing, physician relations, operations) to support outreach campaigns, communications, and onboarding activities. Assist in coordinating provider-facing initiatives such as events, mailings, and meetings.

**Travel Support:**

Participate in occasional local travel within California to support provider meetings, events, or onboarding activities, as needed.

**The Skills, Experience & Education You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or related field *(or equivalent experience)*
* 2–4 years of experience in healthcare, provider relations, operations, coordination, or related field
* Experience supporting projects, programs, or operational workflows
* Familiarity with healthcare environments, provider networks, or managed care preferred

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with physicians or provider offices in an administrative or support capacity
* Exposure to onboarding, credentialing, or provider operations processes

The Compensation for this position is **$56,925 - $74,520/year**

In addition, we provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs.

* Excellent medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 401k savings plan with a company match
* Flexible time off and 9 Paid Holidays

**Final salary determination will take into account the candidate’s geographic location, experience, and qualifications.**

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
The American Lung Association has an excellent opportunity for a **Development Coordinator.** Working as a member of the **Development** department, you will join an outstanding group of professionals dedicated to our mission: to save lives by improving lung health and preventing lung disease through research, education, and advocacy.

Works together with the Development Team to coordinate the annual San Francisco Fight For Air Climb (FFA Climb). Responsible for achieving revenue goals through participant and team recruitment and relationship building. This position also has responsibility for supporting the Fight For Air Climb in Los Angeles. Plays a key role in the execution of events through the management of volunteers, timeline, logistics, event collateral, and platform management.

**Location:**

The position is located at the American Lung Association’s San Ramon, California office and will be a hybrid of in-person and virtual work.

**Responsibilities:**

* Together with the Development Manager, implement the area development plan through special events and other revenue sources.
* Coordinate planning for fundraising or stewardship events. Recruit, train & supervise event day volunteers. Prepare reports as required. Execute the constituent engagement plan using various electronic systems.
* Work together with members of the events team to meet or exceed annual revenue goals. Participate in the creation, planning and implementation of new and existing projects.
* Coordinate and oversee event logistics: develop and monitor event project timelines and implementation. Negotiate with vendors to achieve favorable prices that ensure adherence to established budget. Prepare and monitor ongoing event progress reports.
* Recruit, coordinate and coach community event team captains and volunteers. Cultivate relationships and effectively engage volunteers. Work with the Development Team to increase event participation and revenue. Serve as liaison for customer service and troubleshooting for signature events and internal kickoffs.
* Serve as location lead for the development of event websites and content updates, utilizing ALA best practices, software and guidelines.
* Coordinate the implementation of e-communications, mailings and donor acknowledgements.
* Work with the Marketing and Communications department to create and disseminate special events promotional materials.
* Oversee the utilization of ALA databases and e-commerce platforms, Donor Drive & ROI, serves as special events lead on ROI.
* Complete special projects as assigned by the Development Manager or Executive Director.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management or a related field is preferred; equivalent combinations of education and relevant work experience will also be considered.
* One or two years of fundraising experience preferred with experience recruiting and coordinating volunteers.
* Superb organizational and time management skills with excellent attention to detail and independent follow-through in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong computer skills with website communication, social media and database systems.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A team player with a positive attitude; comfortable working with all levels of staff
* Must have a valid Driver’s license and your own reliable transportation with the ability to travel within assigned area 30% of the time for meetings and conferences, as well as the flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends with some overnights required
* Ability to lift and carry 25 lbs. (event supplies)
* Consistent with its mission, the American Lung Association maintains a smoke-free workplace; all employees must abstain from tobacco use in any form, including vaping.

**Compensation:** Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The target hiring range for this position is between $46,800 and $54,000 per annum.

**Benefits**: The Lung Association offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Paid Leave - 10 vacation days in the first year (15 days thereafter), 2 personal days and 15 sick days per year, as well as 12 company-paid holidays per year. We also offer Paid Parental Leave for eligible employees.
* Insurance - Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in our medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as voluntary plans for critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, short-term disability and supplemental life/AD&D insurance. Employees will be enrolled in company-paid life/AD&D and long-term disability Insurance coverage.
* Retirement Plan - Eligible employees can participate in our 401(k) Defined Contribution Retirement Plan, which offers matching employer contributions (up to 4%) and year-end discretionary non-elective contributions.
