jobs.title: Account Manager - Packaging Industry
jobs.description:
**Who is Golden West Packaging Group (GWPG)?**

We are a leading West Coast mill-independent specialty packaging and printing business. We are the people behind the innovative packaging solutions that make it possible for our customers’ products to reach our community – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between.

With 13 manufacturing facilities primarily in California and Washington state, our extensive production capabilities include structural and graphic design, value-added converting, flexographic printing, and lithographic lamination. Our advanced, environmentally sustainable packaging solutions serve a wide range of well-known customer brands across multiple industries including agriculture, food services, medical device, food products, wineries, high tech, pharma, cosmetics and many more!

**Why is Golden West Packaging Group THE place to work?**

We are a well-established, growing company in a stable industry that is re-imagining itself to be a place where everyone knows everyone, where you can make a difference, and where you can learn and grow professionally.

We are focused on safety and building an employee-centric work environment where team members can experience camaraderie, relevance, and career advancement.

As the packaging and logistics sector continues to grow, we’re growing with it and creating new opportunities. Come make your mark at a company that strives to celebrate your individuality, skills, and talents.

At Golden West Packaging Group, you’ll feel the difference and make a difference

**The Role You’ll Play**

The primary responsibility of the person in this position is to strategically grow sales and increase the Golden West (GW)’s profitability by developing, leading, and driving the GWPG sales strategy to identify and gain sales contracts that benefit the customer and advance Golden West profitable business growth strategies.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and target new business opportunities through strategic prospecting, market research and networking
* Conduct sales presentations, pitches, and product demonstrations to showcase our packaging solutions
* Collaborate with other team members on the development of customized packaging products and service solutions to increase customer satisfaction and optimize GW’s sales profitability within a given product or market category.
* Generate new business opportunities in assigned categories to grow sales and increase Golden West’s market share
* Forecast sales projections, track performance metrics, and provide regular reports to management
* Stay current to market and customer trends and developments for given categories to identify new sales opportunities to expand existing customer sales volumes and new sales opportunities
* Ensure sales meet contributions margin requirements and ensure GW’s business sustainability
* Develop strategies to expand GW’s business and profitability
* Research competition and business climate for category to identify and mitigate risk of potential business threats and to optimize potential business opportunities
* Serve as the primary point of contact for existing customers, building strong relationships and understanding their needs
* Define business plans and strategies for assigned category to gain market share and maximize profitability and execute against such strategies to achieve plans

**What You’ll Get**

* A friendly, team-based, supportive work environment
* Competitive total compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, vision, dental, life insurance, and 401K plan with employer contribution
* Employee Assistance coverage with full services, including dietary and nutritional services, retirement planning and support services
* 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid time off
* Progressive employee referral program
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

If this sounds like you and if you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, we invite you to apply today!

**What You’ll Need**

**Required skills, knowledge and abilities:**

* Effective sales skills using a data-based, solution sales approach
* Proven track record of successful selling
* Strong organizational skills, discipline and attention to detail
* Customer focused mentality and approach to business
* Expert knowledge and understanding of industry packaging needs and solutions
* Strong verbal and written communications skills
* Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong collaboration, interpersonal and relationship building skills

**Required education and experience:**

* B.S/A. in business administration or related field
* 5+ years of experience in sales and solutions sales with a proven track record of success
* Experience in packaging industry is desired

Golden West Packaging Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)
jobs.description:
**Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)**
============================================

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager / Technical Manager**

**Overview of Role**

TSMC North America is seeking an Account Manager / Technical Manager, based in San Jose, CA, to own the technical account relationship for one of TSMC’s key global customers serving diverse sectors, including data center, networking, broadband, and industrial markets. You will serve as a primary interface between the customer’s technical and procurement organizations, driving and managing both front-end silicon technology and backend packaging programs (2.5D/3D advanced packaging). The role demands fluency in semiconductor design, processes, and advanced packaging, strong commercial acumen, and the emotional intelligence to build synergy within an established, high-workload account team while operating independently and keeping tight alignment with TSMC headquarters. You will report to the Account Management team leader and partner with senior customer and TSMC stakeholders to strengthen the partnership and deliver measurable value across cost, quality, and time-to-market. TSMC currently operates a hybrid work schedule (4 days in office).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the account relationship for the assigned strategic customer, serving as the primary TSMC technical and commercial interface and sustaining executive-level alignment.
* Manage the customer’s selected front-end silicon and advanced packaging programs — 2.5D/3D packaging — from planning through production ramp. Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding customer’s product roadmaps and positioning the appropriate TSMC technologies.
* Translate customer product requirements into actionable programs with R&D, Planning, Field Technical Support (FTS), Business Development, Operations, and Finance, and coordinate closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Anticipate and address customer challenges, balancing TSMC’s objectives with the customer’s product and operational priorities.
* Manage capacity and fulfillment cycles with procurement, design, and business units, ensuring consistent demand creation and supply alignment.
* Provide structured business analysis and briefings for Account Directors, VPs, and senior TSMC executives.

***Minimum Qualifications***

* BS/MS in Engineering, Physical Science, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of combined experience in account management, applications/field engineering, technical program management, or foundry/OSAT/OEM supply chain within the semiconductor industry.
* Strong knowledge of semiconductor processes, fab operations, and supply chain dynamics.
* Strong project management with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business insights into clear executive recommendations.
* High emotional intelligence and proven ability to build strong working relationships and integrate into an established, capacity-constrained, customer-facing team.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and conflict‑management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ability to analyze and interpret financial statements.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Prior TSMC or foundry account management / customer service experience supporting North America accounts.
* Experience in semiconductor design, device, process, product engineering, or advanced packaging.
* Experience coordinating across highly matrixed, multi-geography teams and with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Bilingual in Mandarin and English.

***Travel Expectations***

* Monthly travel (~10%) to customer sites within the USA.
* Annual travel to TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.

**Company Description**

As a trusted technology and capacity provider, TSMC is driven by the desire to be:

* **The world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry**
* **The technology leader with a strong reputation for manufacturing excellence**
* **Advancing semiconductor manufacturing innovations to enable the future of technology**

TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. The Company supports a thriving ecosystem of global customers and partners with the industry’s leading process technologies and a portfolio of design enablement solutions to unleash innovation for the global semiconductor industry. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

**Export Control**

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations, including Export Administration Regulations, TSMC North America may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Government for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon TSMC North America obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by the U.S. Government.

TSMC North America is committed to employing a diverse workforce and provides Equal Employment Opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are seeking a highly driven, entrepreneurial, and results-oriented National Account Manager to lead and grow our Biscoff business at Target. This individual will own the Target business, including strategy, revenue growth, profitability, operational execution, and cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will serve as the internal expert on all things Target and be accountable for delivering sustainable, profitable growth.

Strategic Account Leadership

* Develop and execute the overall Target account strategy to deliver revenue, share, distribution, and profit objectives.
* Own annual business plans, customer growth strategies, assortment recommendations, promotional plans, and innovation launches.
* Lead Joint Business Planning initiatives and identify opportunities to expand the business within Target stores and digital channels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across Target buying, planning, inventory, and merchandising teams.

* Proficient in syndicated data platforms (Nielsen, IRI, SPINS) and capable of turning insights into compelling customer-facing stories.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently, while thriving in a nimble, entrepreneurial environment.

To be determined.

jobs.title: Service Account Manager
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy customer service and building meaningful connections? Are you self-driven and find excitement in sales activities?

As a **Service Account Manager**, you will have the opportunity to actively seek out, manage, and nurture a portfolio of key accounts within the mechanical contracting industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide exceptional customer service while fostering strong relationships with both new and existing clients. The Service Account Manager will use their expertise and industry knowledge to navigate customers through the sales process and ensure satisfaction with our products and services.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Develop and manage a portfolio of key accounts in the mechanical industry specializing in service agreements, repairs and projects.
* Drive client engagement and satisfaction by evaluating operations through on-site inspections and offer expert HVAC, plumbing and piping solutions that are tailored to client’s needs.
* Proactively generate new business through prospecting, cold calling, emails, and onsite meetings with prospective clients.
* Identify growth potential with existing accounts, analyzing performance, and developing strategies to enhance client satisfaction, retention, and revenue.
* Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, tracking customer interactions, forecasts, and presenting updates during monthly meetings.
* Create detailed proposals for new and existing clients, outlining scopes of work tailored to their unique requirements.
* Follow up with submitted customer proposals on a weekly basis, maintaining communication to address inquiries or modifications.
* Tracks annual contract renewals, engaging with clients prior to expiration for repeat business.
* Identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities for Plumbing services by collaborating with internal partners to deliver comprehensive service offerings.
* Maintain a competitive edge by staying abreast of market trends, emerging technologies, and industry advancements within the assigned region.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and act as a liaison between clients and various departments within SVM.

**EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2+ years’ experience as a HVAC Account Manager or Sales Representative **required**.
* 2+ years’ experience working with a Mechanical Contractor or related field **required**.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED; or equivalent combination of education and experience) **required.**
* Proficient knowledge of HVAC systems and terminology utilized in the Mechanical Industry **required.**
* Proven experience successfully establishing and managing a book of business **required.**
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude with experience writing grammatically correct customer proposals **required.**
* Proven ability to overcome objections and challenges with customers **required.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to maintain strong relationships **required.**
* Highly proficient with various office equipment and programs including MS Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel), Accounting Software or a CRM **required.**
* Possesses a valid California’s Driver’s License and willing to submit to a DMV report **a must.**

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE**

This is a full-time exempt position. The compensation for this role is $100,000- $170,000 annually and is based on experience and skillset.

**Health:** Medical / Dental / Vision / Life & Disability Insurance / FSA

**Well-Being**: Robust Maternity & Paternity Leave / EAP / Paid Holidays / PTO / Sick Leave / Interactive Breakroom

**Financial Wellness**: Deferred Compensation Plan / 401k w/ Employer Contribution / Employee Referral Bonus / “Positive Pulse”

**Community Investment**: Volunteer Opportunities / Team Building Activities / Employee Activities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

As a Service Account Manager the Mechanical Contracting Industry, there are certain physical requirements you should be aware of. These requirements ensure that you are capable of performing the necessary tasks safely and effectively. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified applicants who may not be able to fulfil certain aspects of the role. The key physical requirements for this role are outlined below:

* This role may involve physical activity including walking, standing, climbing, and driving to customer sites.
* This role may requirecarrying equipment, samples, or marketing materials when visiting customers which could result in carrying up to 50lbs.
* This role may require working at elevated heights and changing work conditions while surveying customer equipment including construction sites and commercial buildings.
* This role may require navigating through tight spaces, such as crawlspaces, attics, or mechanical rooms to review customer equipment.
* This role may require reviewing and interpreting technical specifications, equipment manuals and other relevant documents.
* This role may require the use of ladders and personal protective equipment (PPE) during customer site visits.

**WHO WE ARE**

At SVM, we are more than just a leading mechanical contractor specializing in design-build commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, service/maintenance, and 24-hour emergency services. We’re a team dedicated to supporting the Bay Area, Sacramento, and Nevada regions with trusted expertise and an unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional experiences at every level.

Our success is built on a collaborative culture that values teamwork, innovation, and doing the right thing. We take pride in fostering an inclusive and welcoming environment where every team member feels supported, valued, and empowered to grow. At SVM, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize their development, well-being, and success.

Our state-of-the-art fabrication facility reflects our dedication to quality and efficiency. B

jobs.title: Strategic Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Diodes Incorporated is seeking a Strategic Account Sales Manager responsible for new business development, revenue growth, and strategic account management within a select group of major accounts. The successful candidate will support customers in identifying products, solutions, and services that best meet their needs while driving demand creation, design wins, and long-term growth opportunities. This position serves as the primary interface between the customer and Diodes' Business Units (BUs), Field Applications Engineers (FAEs), Marketing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.

**Principle Duties and Responsibility:**

* Build and manage Account Plans for each assigned account and territory, keeping the extended team of stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned to achieve growth objectives.
* Develop, communicate, and execute customer-specific account strategies based on compelling value propositions that drive new business opportunities and revenue growth.
* Own the design, deployment, and execution of winning account strategies to identify and capture every viable project, design opportunity, and revenue stream within assigned accounts.
* Drive demand creation activities by identifying customer roadmaps, projects, applications, and emerging technologies, aligning Diodes' product portfolio with customer requirements.
* Lead design-in and design-win activities across all Business Units to secure production business and increase market share.
* Develop and maintain an extensive knowledge base of assigned accounts, including business structure, technology roadmaps, key stakeholders, competitive landscape, purchasing processes, organizational dynamics, and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate closely with Business Unit Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and FAEs to position products, develop technical solutions, and successfully close new design opportunities.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical reviews, executive meetings, and strategic planning sessions to strengthen customer relationships and uncover growth opportunities.
* Act as the primary escalation point for competitive, technical, quality, qualification, delivery, and commercial issues.
* Maintain accurate sales funnels, forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and account plans, providing visibility to Business Units and management on future revenue opportunities.
* Track and drive design wins from concept through production, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution.
* Communicate customer roadmaps, market trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities to Business Units to influence product development priorities and go-to-market strategies.
* Coordinate globally across sales organizations, Business Units, engineering teams, supply chain, and operations to facilitate alignment and strategic account execution.
* Conduct face-to-face customer management meetings as necessary to provide support, address issues, communicate updates, and build executive-level relationships.
* Negotiate and facilitate business matters including pricing, contracts, supply commitments, delivery schedules, and commercial agreements.
* Lead cross-functional teams consisting of Sales, FAEs, Product Marketing, Business Units, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Global Operations to achieve account objectives and revenue targets.
* Operate effectively within a highly matrixed global organization while driving accountability and execution across multiple functional groups.
* Respect and comply with all Diodes personnel, sales, proposal, and contract policies, while operating within company travel and expense guidelines.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* 5+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry with strategic account management, key account management, and/or territory management responsibilities.
* Proven success managing large strategic customers and complex sales opportunities within OEM, Cloud, AI, Industrial, Consumer, Communications, Networking, Computing, or Automotive markets.
* Preferred BSEE or BS degree with relevant semiconductor, electronics, or technology industry experience.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand customer architectures, product requirements, design challenges, and competitive solutions.
* Demonstrated experience driving demand creation, design-in, and design-win activities resulting in measurable revenue growth.
* Thorough understanding of semiconductor market dynamics, customer buying behaviors, competitive positioning, and industry trends.
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate global cross-functional resources to remove barriers and achieve customer and revenue objectives.
* Strong forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills with customers at engineering, procurement, management, and executive levels.
* Proven ability to build trust-based relationships and influence decision-makers throughout customer organizations.
* Ability to identify customer roadmaps and translate future technology requirements into actionable business opportunities for Diodes.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, responsiveness, follow-up discipline, and commitment to execution.
* Proven history of exceeding quota, achieving revenue targets, and delivering measurable business results in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Ability to effectively assess business opportunities, understand customer motivations, and develop winning sales strategies.
* Experience working successfully within a highly matrixed, multinational organization.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM-based opportunity management systems.

Diodes Incorporated (Nasdaq: DIOD), a Standard and Poor’s SmallCap 600 and Russell 3000

GPJ is hiring an Account Manager to join our growing team.

This role is hybrid, requiring you to report on-site to one of the following office locations a minimum of 2 days/week: Austin, Boston, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York City, or San Francisco.

**Your Role**

You are responsible for making sure that projects within your area of responsibility meet their timelines and budget requirements. Your focus is on a smaller scope, but you take this accountability seriously. You also have the task of keeping margin levels in check for the portfolio you've been assigned. This includes managing any service changes that may come up.

Maintaining a strong strategic responsibility and owning client relationships is a key part of your role. You work to build trust and engagement with both your clients and vendors, internal stakeholders, team members, and other departments. You view things through the client lens.

In addition, you support program direction, objectives, and plans. You possess proficiency in our tools (CRM, Deltek, etc) as well as thorough understanding of our processes. Another aspect of your role is to negotiate and collaborate effectively with internal staff. This collaboration is crucial in driving client success and ensuring account profitability. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94104

Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we have a team distributed across the NAM and EMEA regions.

We’re a bootstrapped and profitable company (over $29M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word-of-mouth excitement. **Job Description**

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility, and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on-street bicycle facilities (1,200+ lane-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit seeks to hire a Program Operations Coordinator to assist the Chief of Cycling & Micromobility with administrative and programmatic duties. The Program Operations Coordinator will be responsible for managing the Chief’s calendar and scheduling meetings with internal and external entities. The Program Operations Coordinator will report on the Chief’s schedule and support meeting preparation by developing agendas, coordinating materials, taking minutes, and ensuring participants’ attendance. Responsibilities also include preparing and maintaining reports on incoming and completed requests and initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timeliness; flagging emails requiring timely follow-up; and coordinating regular unit progress reports for DOT leadership.
  
  
The selected candidate will maintain organized filing systems to ensure proper recordkeeping and accessibility and support improvements to the Unit’s file management system. The selected candidate will collaborate with the Unit’s senior leadership team and staff across DOT to address complex issues or escalate matters as needed. The selected candidate will work closely with OLS’s Director of Administration on administrative duties and procurement activities that support the Chief and the Unit. Additional duties may include filing and maintaining employee documentation, such as sick leave records; compiling tasks and standards and performance evaluations; and coordinating staff grant sheets. The selected candidate will coordinate external partner contacts, potentially conduct field observations, support outreach events, and provide general project support for the Unit’s programs and initiatives. The selected candidate will manage all aspects of the distribution of NYC DOT’s Bike Map, including coordinating with bicycle retailers citywide, managing shipments, and maintaining inventory. The selected candidate will coordinate all correspondence and mail, ensuring the Chief of Cycling & Micromobility receives external correspondence and that responses are prepared accordingly. The candidate will also support the Cycling & Micromobility Unit’s customer service coordination by assisting with processing correspondence, distributing assignments to appropriate staff, tracking responses, and drafting responses to correspondence received through NYC DOT’s public-facing website, the Mayor’s Office, the 311 Call Center, social media posts, and hard-copy mail addressed to the Commissioner related to the Unit’s projects and initiatives.
  
  
This position may require work on weekends and evenings to participate in staffing events and workshops across the city. The ideal candidate is passionate about expanding the reach of cycling in New York City, is well organized, and has strong communication skills, writing, verbal, and people skills to effectively respond to a variety of inquiries in a professional and courteous manner in compliance with NYC DOT standards.
  
  
The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About City Winery**

Imagine a sold-out show, a glass of wine made on-site, and a great dinner, all under one roof. That's City Winery. Every year we produce thousands of concerts and hundreds of wines across ten live entertainment venues in nine metropolitan areas. Each venue is also a working winery and restaurant. We also run five standalone restaurants and winegardens.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our digital marketing team and help fill the room, night after night. Reporting to our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll build, launch, and optimize paid social and programmatic campaigns that turn a scroll into a ticket sale, and you'll see the results of your work in real time as shows sell out.

This is an entry-level role built for learning. From day one you'll manage live campaigns on the major ad platforms, work with real budgets, and learn performance marketing fundamentals from an experienced team. Because the team is small, your ideas and your work will be seen and will make a real difference. If you love digital marketing and want to start your career in live music, food, and wine, we'd love to meet you.  
  
 **What You'll Do**

* Build and launch digital ad campaigns for shows at City Winery venues on platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, StackAdapt, Vibe, and LinkedIn.
* Monitor and optimize ad spend, CPA, and ROAS so every dollar works as hard as possible.
* Write and refresh ad copy that matches the City Winery brand voice, priority keywords, and website messaging.
* Test new ideas across creative, audiences, and targeting, measure what works, and share what you learn with the team.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and turn the numbers into clear takeaways.
* Work with local marketing teams at each venue so campaigns support their show calendars and overall strategy.
* Help track progress against annual paid media goals.
* Implement AI Search and SEO tactics that improve search performance, including maintaining search listings and updating website content.
* Support other digital marketing priorities such as email, and SMS as needed.
* Keep up with digital advertising trends and bring new ideas to the table.

  
**What You'll Learn**  

* How to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across multiple paid social and programmatic platforms
* How to read performance data and connect ad spend to ticket sales
* How live events are marketed, from announcement to on-sale to sold out
* How AI tools can speed up campaign creation, testing, and reporting
* How a small, fast-moving digital team works across ecommerce, venues, and brand

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the curiosity to ask questions when something isn't clear
* A basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Coursework, internships, and personal projects all count.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, especially spreadsheets
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines on your own
* A tech-savvy mindset and interest in how AI tools can make marketing smarter and faster
* A genuine passion for music, food, wine, and live entertainment
* Based in New York City, with potential, occasional travel to other City Winery locations

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, StackAdapt, Vibe, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or other analytics tools
* Experience managing local listings

**About Us**

Wine, food, and live entertainment collide at City Winery to create a dynamic and incredibly unique workplace. Since 2008, City Winery has been turning heads across the nation with amazing live performances, delectable cuisine, and award winning, locally produced wines. But there's more to us than that we're a haven for community and creativity, a place where the philosophy of hospitality is more than just a buzzword, but a way of life. City Winery, founded by music industry veteran & visionary Michael Dorf, has established itself as a one-of-a-kind brand providing unforgettable experiences for guests. From world class music venues to sustainably produced wines with ratings of 90+ points, City Winery offers a range of topnotch events & experiences.

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at City Winery. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Additionally, City Winery participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.**

jobs.description:
**Job Title**: **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator**

**Location**: Hoboken, NJ

**Division:** Management

**Department:** Marketing

**About Us:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Scope of the Job:**

QCi is seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator** to help plan and execute the company’s tradeshows, conferences, exhibitions, customer events, and industry engagements.

This highly visible, travel-intensive position supports the full event lifecycle, including pre-event planning, exhibitor logistics, vendor coordination, shipping, booth setup, on-site operations, teardown, return shipping, and post-event reporting. The Coordinator will work closely with the Tradeshow & Events Specialist and partner with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Engineering, and executive leadership to deliver professional, engaging, and well-organized event experiences.

The ideal candidate enjoys live-event environments, takes initiative, stays composed when plans change, and is comfortable jumping in wherever needed. This position is well suited for someone who combines strong project coordination skills with a practical, hands-on approach to event execution.

**What You’ll Do**

**Tradeshow and Event Operations**

* Support the planning and execution of tradeshows, conferences, exhibitions, customer events, and other industry engagements.
* Travel to event locations to provide hands-on support before, during, and after each event.
* Assist with booth setup and teardown, including displays, graphics, signage, furniture, technology, literature, and promotional materials.
* Confirm that event materials, equipment, technology, and services are delivered, organized, tested, and ready before an event opens.
* Maintain a clean, organized, fully stocked, and professional booth environment throughout each event.
* Manage packing, labeling, return shipping, and the safe storage of event materials following each event.
* Troubleshoot shipping, vendor, technology, and operational issues in real time.

**Event Planning and Logistics**

* Maintain event timelines, project plans, checklists, staffing schedules, registrations, exhibitor requirements, sponsorship deliverables, and key deadlines.
* Coordinate event services such as freight, drayage, electrical, internet, AV, furniture, catering, labor, and booth support.
* Assist with hotel and travel logistics for participating employees and executives, as needed.
* Prepare signage, marketing collateral, literature, promotional items, giveaways, and event supplies.
* Create and maintain packing lists, standardized event kits, run-of-show documents, and other event-planning materials.
* Participate in pre-event planning meetings, on-site briefings, and post-event debriefs.

**Vendor and Partner Coordination**

* Communicate with event organizers, venues, general contractors, freight and drayage providers, AV partners, printers, booth vendors, and promotional-item suppliers.
* Obtain and organize vendor quotes, orders, invoices, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Monitor vendor activities before and during events to ensure requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Escalate potential risks and help resolve logistical or operational issues quickly and professionally.

**On-Site Event Support**

* Provide on-site support to Sales, Business Development, executives, engineers, customers, and partners.
* Coordinate booth coverage, staffing schedules, customer meetings, product demonstrations, presentations, receptions, and related activities.
* Welcome attendees and help create an engaging and professional QCi experience.
* Support lead capture and ensure attendee information is accurately recorded and routed for timely follow-up.
* Monitor booth traffic, inventory, supplies, technology, and overall presentation.
* Respond professionally to last-minute requests, shifting priorities, and changing event requirements.

**Event Inventory and Asset Management**

* Maintain accurate inventory of booth properties, displays, signage, literature, promotional items, technology, and event supplies.
* Coordinate replenishment, printing, and distribution of event materials.
* Ensure event assets are packed, labeled, stored, and prepared for future use.
* Identify missing, damaged, outdated, or low-stock materials and coordinate appropriate follow-up.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration and Reporting**

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management.

  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed. The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  
  
About the team  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

  
Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.description:
### **Description**

Headquartered in the Pacific Northwest, Wyld produces the best Cannabis tasting edibles and beverages on the market using real fruit and natural flavors. When adventure calls, we answer - always ready to embrace challenges, test boundaries, and push limits. Our company ethos is founded in strong values and our Pillars of Commitment to our communities and the Earth itself. Our ambitious team embraces challenges, tests boundaries, and is always ready for adventure. Wyld operates in AZ, CA, CO, IL, MA, MD, MI, MO, NM, NV, NJ, NY, OH, OR, OK, WA, and across all of Canada with more launches on the horizon.

Ability to excel in a fast-growing/fast paced environment delivering accuracy while managing to deadlines where adaptability is imperative.

Embody Wyld Core Values, The Wyld Way

Wyld’s core values are the driving force and energy behind everything we do. These values drive our culture, our business philosophy and our philanthropic efforts. It is the cornerstone for all that we do here at Wyld.  

* Make a Mark

* We Blaze Our Own Trail
* Brand First
* We Mean Business

**Summary**  
  
The **Sales Account Manager** is responsible for overseeing state sales in all Wyld product channels with a focus on major retailers. You will be responsible for your own sales quota for total state sales. As State Manager you will work with our distribution partners and independently to secure new placements, develop existing business, and educate our customers on our brand and products.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and implement sale strategies
  + Utilize in-person and phone sales calls to prospect new business and build existing accounts
  + Work with distributor partners to gain placements in on and off premise accounts
  + Develop distributor rep knowledge about the product and ensure Wyld is front of mind on their sales calls
  + Build relationships with key accounts and develop strategies to increase product velocity and shelf presence
  + Work with retailers to implement promotions and incentives
  + Attend relevant trade shows and events
  + Keep partners informed of new products, upcoming innovations, and effective sales strategies
  + Monitors competitors to gauge market trends and defend market share
* Analyzes sales data and reporting
  + Analyze product and sales data monthly to find opportunities for growth while also following market trends
  + Attend sales meetings to discuss trends, data, goals and provide feedback on industry shifts
* Oversee distribution performance
  + Clearly communicate with distribution partner leaders and sales reps ensuring strategic information is funneled to the appropriate team members
  + Responsible for the engagement and development of distributor partner reps with product knowledge
  + Provide coaching to ensure they have the resources necessary to secure placements
* Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned based on business needs

### **Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* 5+ years of experience in direct sales, sales operations, or related field
* CPG and wholesaler management experience are a plus
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to professionally interact with managers, staff and officers at all levels of the organization with diplomacy and professionalism
* Not afraid to take ownership; demonstrates a growth mindset
* Effectively communicate information and respond to questions/suggestions from various levels within the company
* Ability to present brand information in a clear and engaging manner
* Will be required to submit to a background check and motor vehicle reporting check
* Travel through territory will be required (up to 90%)

  

### **Benefits**

As a exempt employee**, you'll receive a competitive salary of $80,000 -100,000k/yr. starting rate + plus commission potential, 11 paid holidays, 120 hours of PTO, 16 hours of VTO, 401K, and** **fully paid health, dental and vision insurance.**

**Wyld is an equal opportunity employer**

### **About WYLD**

Wyld was founded in 2016 with the goal of creating high-quality, real fruit-infused cannabis edibles. Since then, we've grown into America's top edible brand, driven by a commitment to excellence, community partnerships, and integrity. We’re proud to support social justice, environmental sustainability, and wellness, while continuing to expand our reach and impact.

**Our Opportunity**

GPJ is hiring an Account Manager to join our growing team.

This role is hybrid, requiring you to report on-site to one of the following office locations a minimum of 2 days/week: Austin, Boston, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York City, or San Francisco.

**Your Role**

You are responsible for making sure that projects within your area of responsibility meet their timelines and budget requirements. Your focus is on a smaller scope, but you take this accountability seriously. You also have the task of keeping margin levels in check for the portfolio you've been assigned. This includes managing any service changes that may come up.

Maintaining a strong strategic responsibility and owning client relationships is a key part of your role. You work to build trust and engagement with both your clients and vendors, internal stakeholders, team members, and other departments. You view things through the client lens.

In addition, you support program direction, objectives, and plans. You possess proficiency in our tools (CRM, Deltek, etc) as well as thorough understanding of our processes. You provide a high level of client service and satisfaction, all while ensuring that you consistently and efficiently deploy GPJ methodologies.

Another aspect of your role is to negotiate and collaborate effectively with internal staff. This collaboration is crucial in driving client success and ensuring account profitability. You actively engage with the greater Account Management Practice, including bi-monthly calls, and Slack channel discussions.

Lastly, you may have the opportunity to mentor, manage, lead and develop members of the account team. It's important to support the growth and development of your colleagues in this dynamic role.

**Travel & Mobility**

jobs.description:
**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

**About the Role**
------------------

Order.co is hiring its first Executive Assistant, a highly trusted partner to our CEO, Zach Garippa, and one of the most leveraged roles in the company. Reporting to the Chief of Staff and working with the CEO every day, you will help our founder and CEO operate at his highest level by protecting his focus, creating clarity amid complexity, and ensuring the right things happen at the right time. This is not a traditional administrative role. It's a role for someone who thrives at the center of a fast-growing business, exercises exceptional judgment, and enjoys turning complexity into momentum.

Zach is personable, curious, incredibly fast-moving, and fully willing to commit to the bit (ask him how we got the Mahalo Hand). The right person will enjoy that energy, know when to match it, and confidently bring order to the chaos, including telling very senior people, “Not today.”

Zach runs at a distinctive pace: he is often up and working early, usually with a Celsius nearby, and brings the same commitment to Solidcore several times a week. He is deeply invested in the people around him and tends to blur the line between colleague and community - in the best way. As in: you may find yourself invited to one of his kids’ birthday parties! You are not expected to adopt his wake-up time, but you should enjoy the energy, candor, and humanity that come with supporting him.

The best Executive Assistants don't just keep executives organized. They increase their effectiveness. That's the role we're hiring for. If you make complicated things feel easy, spot what others miss, and take pride in helping people show up at their best, I’d love to talk!

**Why this Role**
-----------------

You'll join Order.co at an inflection point.

We are entering a new chapter of growth, and you'll work directly alongside our CEO and Chief of Staff to help shape how we operate at scale.

The right person won't simply manage a calendar. They'll become a trusted extension of the CEO's judgment, priorities, and operating style.

You'll have a front-row seat to leadership decisions, Board conversations, company strategy, executive hiring, investor relationships, and the day-to-day realities of building a category-defining business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Protect the CEO’s time + attention**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how J.P. Morgan Payments shows up in market - and why customers should care. In this role, you'll turn business and product priorities into a clear narrative and creative strategy that builds authority over time.

As a Vice President, Brand Strategy in J.P. Morgan Payments, you will define the narrative and creative strategy behind our biggest market investments. You'll bring the customer point of view into a complex, global organization and use audience insight to sharpen what we say and make. You'll partner closely with stakeholders, agencies, and our creative studio to ensure the work is coherent across touchpoints and compounds over time.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Translate business, product, and go-to-market priorities into a clear market narrative and creative strategy.
* Define an audience-centered point of view that builds brand authority and cultural capital over time.
* Steward how the brand shows up across flagship programs and key touchpoints.
* Own audience testing end-to-end, including participants, questions, and stimulus.
* Balance learning (what resonates) with validation (what we must prove to build alignment and confidence).
* Partner with agencies to distill findings into clear, actionable recommendations that elevate the work.
* Partner with the creative studio to define what the work must accomplish and what “good” looks like.
* Use audience insight to guide decisions—sharpening metaphors, focusing copy, and raising creative craft.
* Define clear assignments and translate competing stakeholder input into usable direction for agency partners.
* Lead agency partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.
* Leverage marketing science to raise the standard for how a matrixed organization shows up in market.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Apply marketing science to build strategies and drive focus (including category entry points, the 95:5 rule, and System 1/System 2 thinking).
* Build an audience-centered point of view that earns authority through the work, not just claims.
* Distill ambiguity and competing inputs into a clear path forward.
* Influence stakeholders without formal authority, knowing when to hold the line and when to compromise.
* Bring deep audience obsession, pressure-testing decisions against what matters to customers.
* Translate complexity into a coherent narrative that connects across touchpoints and compounds over time.
* Operate fluidly across strategy and execution—moving from insight to assignment to strong delivery.
* Rally teams around a shared vision and change minds, including in resistant rooms.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Bring experience building brand and narrative strategy inside a highly matrixed, global organization.
* Demonstrate strong partnership with creative teams, with comfort shaping work through craft (not personal taste).

Aozora Community is a vibrant and welcoming educational community in the heart of Brooklyn, dedicated to nurturing young minds, celebrating Japanese culture, and bringing families together. Across our two locations, we offer a wide range of programs, including Japanese-immersion preschool, infant and toddler classes, after-school enrichment, Japanese language academy, seasonal camps, and adult Japanese classes.

At Aozora, we believe that a caring, collaborative, and supportive environment makes all the difference—not only for the children and families we serve, but also for the people who work here. We value teamwork, creativity, and a shared commitment to making our community a place where everyone feels welcomed, connected, and inspired.

**The Role**

We are looking for a warm, organized, detail-oriented, and proactive School Operations & Administrative Coordinator to join our team and play an essential role in supporting our school community. This is a dynamic, hands-on position that brings together family support, enrollment coordination, financial administration, and day-to-day school operations. You'll be one of the friendly faces welcoming families to Aozora, a trusted resource for our teachers and staff, and an important part of keeping everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys wearing many hats, takes initiative, pays attention to the little details, and approaches challenges with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset. You'll work closely with our leadership, teachers, and administrative team to help create an organized, welcoming, and supportive environment for everyone.

If you love connecting with people, enjoy making things work better, and want to be part of a close-knit team making a meaningful difference in children's lives, we'd love to meet you!

**Enrollment & Family Support**

* Provide timely, professional, and welcoming support to prospective and current families during the enrollment and registration process
* Respond to enrollment inquiries and guide families through the necessary steps
* Organize and maintain admissions paperwork, forms, and onboarding materials
* Maintain program waitlists and support mid-year and seasonal enrollment updates
* Act as the primary contact for inquiries related to the online program enrollment system, addressing billing, invoices, and payment processes for families
* Set up and manage program offerings, schedules, and forms within the online enrollment system
* Work with program teams to ensure accurate reflection of session details and registration options

**Records & Health Compliance**

* Maintain and regularly update student records in our student records system, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality
* Track enrollment data, program participation, and required documentation
* Collaborate with program staff to provide accurate and up-to-date student information as needed
* Collect and manage all student allergy and health-related documentation
* Ensure teachers and staff have access to current allergy information and safety protocols
* Coordinate with families to obtain, update, and store required medical forms in compliance with school policies

**Finance & Operations**

* Accurately record and categorize financial transactions in the accounting system and maintain current ledgers with timely data entry
* Process vendor invoices, reimbursements, and staff expense reports
* Issue payments via approved methods (e.g., check, ACH)
* Track incoming payments and follow up on outstanding balances
* Reconcile monthly bank and credit card statements
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly
* Assist in monitoring the non-personnel budget and flag unusual expenses or inconsistencies
* Manage monthly petty cash reconciliation
* Maintain documentation for restricted and unrestricted funding as needed
* Ensure financial records are audit-ready and compliant
* Collaborate with the Executive Director on reporting and budget tracking
* Coordinate with program staff on the financial tracking of events, supplies, and donations
* Manage procurement of school and office supplies
* Place orders, receive and verify deliveries, and maintain inventory systems
* Work with staff to forecast needs and ensure purchases remain within budget

**Front Office & General Support**

* When stationed at the front desk, serve as the primary point of contact for students, parents, staff, and visitors, maintaining a warm and professional environment
* Monitor building access to ensure safety and security
* Manage phone calls, emails, and in-person inquiries, and route them to the appropriate staff
* Assist with the creation of school communications (e.g., memos, newsletters, reports)
* Support the scheduling of meetings, appointments, and school events
* Collect and distribute daily mail

Success in this role requires strong organization, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, professionalism, and responsiveness in a fast-paced environment.

* Provide day-to-day administrative support for Talent Acquisition senior leaders, including calendar coordination, meeting scheduling, and logistics for team meetings, offsites, and events.

* Support team rhythms, including weekly meetings, through preparation, facilitation support, note capture, and follow-up .

* Serve as a point of coordination for internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, seamless handoffs, and timely follow-up.
* Draft, format, and distribute internal communications, presentations, and materials aligned with excellence standards.
* Support leader preparation for meetings, presentations, and engagements through research, material preparation and logistics support.
* Maintain consistency across administrative processes, tools, and templates for the Talent Acquisition team.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve ways of working and increase team efficiency.
* Build strong working relationships across teams to support collaboration, trust, and effective partnerships.
